The year, priced to its mood.

HOUSE RULES
Defaults that govern the year.
Minimum stay
2 nights

Standard. Rises to 3 in Peak, 4 over New Year.

Check-in window
15:00 — 19:00

Later arrivals by arrangement only.

Cancellation
14 days

Full refund outside window; 50% within.

Lead time
36 hours

Earliest booking before arrival evening.

CHAPTER II
Seasons declared, then honoured.

Rather than fiddle with single nights, define four broad seasons and let them carry the pricing forward. Override only where the calendar — an exhibition opening, a regional holiday, the long quiet of February — asks for it.

CHAPTER III
Distributed, but never duplicated.

When you publish, the calendar pushes outward in three minutes — to the direct booking engine, to Airbnb, to the partner channels you've consented to. We do not list on the larger aggregators; this remains a small, considered audience.
